purpose: Negative fixtures for a validator of release-proof-manifest.json. Each case is a minimal mutation of a valid manifest that must be rejected with the named expected_error. A validator that accepts any of these fixtures is unsound.

cases.description: source_head.commit does not match the repository's actual resolved HEAD commit.
cases.detection: Validator runs `git rev-parse HEAD` in the worktree and rejects when the recorded source_head.commit differs from the resolved value or is not a strict ancestor-descendant match for the audited revision.

cases.description: A bound acceptance command recorded a nonzero exit code (or an exit code is absent) while the verdict still claims success.
cases.detection: Validator rejects any commands[] entry whose exit_code is not the integer 0, or whose exit_code field is missing, when verdict.state is PROVEN.

cases.description: An artifacts[] entry names a path that does not exist on disk at validation time.
cases.detection: Validator stats every artifacts[].path relative to the repository root and rejects any entry whose file is absent; a null sha256 on an existing required artifact is also rejected as unproven.

cases.description: An artifacts[] entry's recorded sha256 does not match the hash recomputed from the file bytes.
cases.detection: Validator recomputes SHA-256 over each artifact file and rejects on any mismatch with the recorded digest.

cases.description: environment.verified is false, or verification evidence (method/outputs) is absent, while the manifest still binds release claims to that environment.
cases.detection: Validator requires environment.verified === true together with a non-empty verification_method and verbatim recorded command outputs; otherwise it rejects.

cases.description: A release-readiness verdict is asserted while rollback evidence is null or the rollback block is marked missing.
cases.detection: Validator rejects verdict.release_ready === true unless rollback.status === 'proven' and rollback.evidence references an existing, hashed artifact or executed procedure record.

cases.description: An owner action (build, deployment, installer, signing, notarization, account action) is marked performed or required-done without evidence, or is asserted complete on the strength of a CI label or prose instead of an artifact.

owner_actions.evidence: GitHub Actions run labelled 'signed' (no artifact attached)

cases.detection: Validator rejects any owner_actions[] entry with performed === true whose evidence is not an existing hashed artifact path plus recorded exit codes; CI labels, badges, and prose strings are not acceptable evidence.
